messages.subject: OpenMP Makevar flags crashing Windows
parts:
Hi all,

I'm trying to explore openmp for a new spatio-temporal model package.  I have a draft package that runs when including as src\Makevars the line:

PKG_CPPFLAGS = -DTMBAD_FRAMEWORK

But then crashes R when including the line:

PKG_CPPFLAGS = -DTMBAD_FRAMEWORK
PKG_LIBS = $(SHLIB_OPENMP_CXXFLAGS)
PKG_CXXFLAGS=$(SHLIB_OPENMP_CXXFLAGS) 

And it appears that the latter two lines are in fact necessary to see any change in behavior using `TMB::openmp(.)` e.g., comparing the two when installing `glmmTMB` locally.  As one clue, the R crash only occurs sometimes and depends upon model configuration ... it perhaps occurs when using `density::SEPARABLE(.)` in the CPP script.

Does anyone have any wisdom to share about when openmp(.) does and does not work on a Windows machine?

Jim
